about: v2.3.5241: one row for each file git tracks under public/ that is a picture, a sound, a video or data (grand plan step 9.1): its bytes, the SHA-256 of its bytes, its family (tools/assets/families.mjs) and its kind. Written by node tools/assets/shipped.mjs --write; never by hand. A row with a "door" field was made by tools/assets/finish.mjs. v2.3.5244: one row a line in path order and no totals (node tools/assets/shipped.mjs prints them), so two PRs that change different files merge with one press; a .webp under public/sprites/player/ or gear/ with its .png beside it is the sprite bot's twin and has no row.
